stem: How are Joey in the story “Good Enough” and the speaker in the poem “Simply Me” SIMILAR?
instruction: Use “Good Enough” and “Simply Me” to answer the following question.

options.label: A
options.text: Both have experienced being wrongfully accused.

options.label: B
options.text: Both have been hurt by being compared to others.

options.label: C
options.text: Both find the strength they need by befriending someone.

options.label: D
options.text: Both find something positive when they shift their focus.
